newsitem.title: USA: Quadrax backlog at record $12 mln.
newsitem.headline: Quadrax backlog at record $12 mln.

text.p: Quadrax Corp said Wednesday that its consolidated operations, including Victor Corp, had a record $12 million order backlog as of June 6, 1997.
Quadrax said that "substantial" amounts of these orders will be shipped in 1997, with some scheduled for 1998 and, in some instances, 1999.
Victor Corp, Quadrax's newly acquired wire and cable company, recently received multi-million dollar purchase agreements from two Fortune 500 companies.
The estimated sales from these purchase agreements are included in the $12 million backlog.
In view of current backlogs and strong indications for new orders, Quadrax said it is doubling its production capacity for golf club shafts, hockey sticks and mountain bike handlebars.
